confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear, multi-day pattern of an insider threat (user_03) systematically accessing and downloading sensitive files outside their authorized department (HR) in both the Finance and Engineering departments.

attack_chain.description: User_03 downloads a confidential finance file (payroll_summary_q1.xlsx) outside their normal HR directory.
User_03 downloads an engineering architecture document (architecture_overview.pdf) outside their normal HR directory.
User_03 downloads a confidential finance budget file (budget_allocation.xlsx).
User_03 downloads a confidential HR salary structure file (salary_structure_2026.xlsx).
User_03 downloads a confidential finance expense report (expense_reports_q1.csv).
User_03 downloads an engineering infrastructure diagram (infrastructure_diagram.pdf).
User_03 downloads a confidential finance revenue file (revenue_by_division.xlsx).

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_03 had any legitimate cross-departmental tasks or tickets that would justify this access.
No information on whether these files were subsequently moved to external storage or sent via email.
narrative: User_03, an HR specialist, engaged in a premeditated pattern of data exfiltration over a seven-day period. The user systematically accessed and downloaded highly sensitive files from the Finance and Engineering departments, which are outside their authorized directory baseline of '/data/hr/'.
